import concurrent.futures, os, socket
host = os.environ['NODE1_IP']
def request(payload):
    with socket.create_connection((host, 9097), timeout=5) as s:
        s.sendall((payload + '\n').encode())
        chunks = []
        while True:
            chunk = s.recv(1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
    return b''.join(chunks).decode()
for i in range(100):
    payload = 'PING' if i % 2 == 0 else 'OTHER'
    expected = 'PONG\n' if payload == 'PING' else 'ERROR\n'
    got = request(payload)
    if got != expected:
        raise SystemExit(f'sequential {i}: expected {expected!r}, got {got!r}')
print('SEQUENTIAL_100=PASS')
payloads = ['PING' if i % 3 == 0 else f'BAD-{i}' for i in range(64)]
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=32) as pool:
    results = list(pool.map(request, payloads))
for i, (payload, got) in enumerate(zip(payloads, results)):
    expected = 'PONG\n' if payload == 'PING' else 'ERROR\n'
    if got != expected:
        raise SystemExit(f'concurrent {i}: expected {expected!r}, got {got!r}')
print('CONCURRENT_64=PASS')
